how_to_find: Open your fork on GitHub and look at the date of the newest commit in the master branch. Match it to the versions below. VERIFY: the repository has no tags or releases that the tools could list, and package.json still says version 1.0.0.

versions.title: Streamable HTTP transport
versions.summary: Commit 62c778c: the server moved from SSE to Streamable HTTP, because Claude deprecated SSE in April 2026. VERIFY: the version name is inferred from the commit date and message.

changes.text: The MCP address is now your Railway URL followed by /mcp, using Streamable HTTP instead of SSE.
A /health address that returns status ok. VERIFY: it exists in the current code; the exact commit that added it is not confirmed.

upgrade_steps.title: Sync your fork
upgrade_steps.text: On GitHub, open your fork and choose Sync fork. Railway redeploys by itself.

upgrade_steps.title: Change the connector address in Claude
upgrade_steps.text: Open Settings, then Connectors. Edit the connector. Set the address to your Railway URL followed by /mcp. Remove any old SSE address.

versions.title: First commit
versions.summary: Commit a62953e: first version of the Node.js server that sends requests to an Apps Script web app, using SSE transport. VERIFY: the version name and contents are inferred from the commit date.

changes.text: Spreadsheet tools for Claude: list, create, read, write, find, update and delete.
